Admin routes of the payment providers module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/payment-providers

List registered payment providers with their config schema

Responses:

- `200`: Providers retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
